learned counsel for the applicant.

for the State.
Mr. Pankaj Semwal, learned counsel 
for the respondent no.2.
2. Learned counsel for the applicant and 
the respondent no.2 are ad idem that there 
are some chances of settlement between the 
parties. The applicant and the respondent 
no.2 may be called in person, since this 
matter emanates out of a matrimonial 
dispute. 
3. Hence, both the parties (Applicant and 
Respondent No.2) are directed to present 
along with their counsel before the 
Mediation Centre of the Court on 
29.10.2026.
4. List before regular court for further  consideration on 05.11.2026. 
5. Interim order dated 09.04.2021 is 
extended till the next date of listing. 
6. The applicant is directed to pay a sum 
of ₹5,000/- to the respondent no.2 on the 
date when she appears before the Mediation 
Centre towards her travelling expenses.
(Siddhartha Sah, J.)
